# Research Analyst

> Research Analyst is an attempt to provide institutional-grade equity and ETF
> research.

Research Analyst synthesizes fundamentals, technicals, macro context, competitor
dynamics, and valuation frameworks into structured 7-step research reports for
equities and ETFs.

## Surfaces

- Web app (same build, two mirror hosts): https://ra.devinfo.dev/ and https://ra.aimlds.org/
- Help & user guide: https://ra.devinfo.dev/help
- Source code (AGPL-3.0; commercial licenses available): https://github.com/nrupala/research-analyst
- API: POST /api/research, /api/compare, /api/resolve, /api/disclaimer — response
  formats json, xml, markdown, html, ts via ?format= or Accept header;
  every payload carries a schema_version.
- MCP (streamable HTTP, JSON-RPC 2.0): POST /mcp — tools `research` and
  `quant`; an API key is required (X-RA-Key header or Authorization: Bearer).

## Data sources

- SEC EDGAR (filings, XBRL financials)
- Market data (prices, estimates, holdings)
- Technical indicators (computed from price data)
- Macro proxies (yields, VIX, indices)

## Model

- No advertising, ever. Monetization is partnerships, services, products, and
  models — never ad networks, never sold user data. Any partner placement is
  explicitly labeled as paid media with the editorial firewall intact.
- For informational and educational purposes only. Not financial advice or a
  recommendation to buy or sell any security.

## Contact
